scope: Two real PeerJS peers connected by a DataConnection in isolated headless Chrome profiles on one machine/network. CDP dispatches mouse and keyboard events; normal client serialization, transport, host authority and guest snapshots run live. Not cross-network NAT, human playtesting, or physical input-device certification.
fixtures: Host QA hooks place humans, disable bots/chaos and give a bow. A read-only data listener records host acceptance of real transport packets. Tagged legacy/invalid input probes use the existing real guest DataConnection, without invoking hostRecv directly. A short host sampler observes transient peck and projectile effects.
